acceptance.description: Release binary is a fresh production build from frozen clean committed source, fixture=false/publishable=true, synchronized0.2.5 package/plugin/catalog/client/tag identity with pinned runtime/licenses/hash receipt. Test/development0.2.4 binaries are not published.

The exact production candidate, without rebuild/substitution, installs and passes actual native Codex timed nonce/K/resume/K/nonce with reading/submission-clock guards and actual Claude marker nonce/K/nonce with fresh input>100000. Preserve raw receipt/source/queue/hook/process/rollout evidence and personal hashes.

After successful verification/review/submit, publish exact verified binary, SHA256SUMS and build receipt with matching source tag and GitHub digest. Preserve older immutable releases, verify anonymous downloaded bytes, then isolate actual install/update/uninstall smoke outside frozen evidence. No automatic issue work.
Compiled CLI/runtime/native assets work after relocation without external Node/Bun on end-user PATH; old versions remain available for running owners.
Owned install/update/repair selection and source migration preserve user settings, native executable, recorded paths and unrelated state.
Stable anonymous update validates candidate identity/platform/hash, respects owned provider subsets, current no-op/catchup and operation locks without downgrade.
Version identities and production receipt agree, public assets are immutable verified outputs and release notes explain native hook trust/relaunch and current platform limits.
Foreign/path conflicts, malformed config, missing providers and invalid transport/candidate forms fail before activation; native registry fault cases remain verified.
Setup remains install alias and discovers available providers with opt-in warming.
Repair restores only owned integrations including source records and preserves saved warming unless --warm.
Custom timers/options, saved warm state and unrelated hooks/settings survive repair/update.
Native hook trust/global disables are never bypassed; readiness and required relaunch are reported honestly.
Late provider/update failure compensates prior registry/config/inventory/activation and reports compensation failure explicitly.
Codex native registration/refresh/removal is reversible, ownership-safe and additive with unrelated hooks.
Exact owner/thread/turn/client attribution, conflicting-owner fail-closed behavior and owned process cleanup remain verified.
Root provider guides describe actual separate Claude/Codex architecture and current activity semantics.
Updated download/version/release-note links are consistent and local links/anchors resolve with retained hash receipt.
Document release upgrade/trust/relaunch, current macOSarm64/zsh scope, actual model usage and unverified cache retention/savings; no private identifiers or unsupported pause/config claims.
Repeatable E2E preserves raw runner-produced evidence, personal config/auth/shell hashes and owned cleanup; native auth/quota/network errors fail honestly. No post-code unit tests.
